description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of several language models across different evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “IT-EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents a score ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, and 1.0, and is labeled “Score”. Each category has a set of three bars representing different models: “RedWhale (our)” in dark blue, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” in medium blue, and “SOLAR-10.7B-(base)” in light blue. Within each category, the bars are grouped side-by-side. For example, in the “IT-EVAL” category, the “RedWhale (our)” bar reaches approximately 0.42, the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” bar reaches approximately 0.52, and the “SOLAR-10.7B-(base)” bar reaches approximately 0.56. The “AVG” category shows the “RedWhale (our)” bar at approximately 0.59, the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” bar at approximately 0.61, and the “SOLAR-10.7B-(base)” bar at approximately 0.69. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order.
